structured_output.content: The release note (ev-4faa7ca81b54) says the Kubernetes Ingress `pathType` changes from `ImplementationSpecific` to `Exact`, but it doesn't say which Ingress resources this covers or when cert-manager creates them. The environment summary lists no Ingress manifests (only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate) and only the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD, so it doesn't show whether this setup uses any Ingress that cert-manager manages. The values key `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole` is set, which hints that HTTP challenge handling is configured, but its value isn't shown. To decide, check whether your issuers use HTTP-based challenges through Ingress, then compare that against PR #7767 and your ingress controller's support for `Exact` paths.
